blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Wind power generated in Puerto Galera is helping stabilize the province’s electricity supply amid critically low power reserves and recurring forecasts of Red Alert conditions, power sector data showed. The Philippine Hybrid Energy Systems Inc. (PHESI) wind farm has supplied electricity to the Oriental Mindoro grid since Nov. 2, with daily generation reaching as high as 16 megawatts (MW), which is its full contracted capacity. Data from the National Transmission Corp.’s (TransCo) Small Island Grid System Operator (SIGSO) Mindoro Control Center showed the wind farm’s output has provided additional supply as conventional power plants struggle with […]...
